title.narrative: Strengthening Rights, Protection and Justice in Syria

description.narrative: The overall objective is to protect and enhance civic space for all people and communities. The specific objectives are 1) a strengthened civil society capacity to participate in political, economic, social, and community life at all levels, including to advocate for participation in a strategic manner; 2) strengthened knowledge of national partners on rights, protection, and justice issues.
